text.en:
Creation -There
is hereby created a Presidential Middle
East Preparedness Committee (PMEPC) under the Office of the President.

Function
PMEPC shall, in relation with the critical
developments
in the Middle East, prepare the appropriate responses, formulate
policies, develop modes for coordination, put into effect all plans approved by the
President and monitor their implementation accordingly, in coordination with the
Department of Foreign Affairs.

Composition
PMEPC shall be composed of the following:
Special envoy to the Middle East, Office of the President
Representative from the Department of Foreign Affairs
Vice-Chairman
Representative from the Department of National Defense
Representative from the Department of Energy
Representative from the Department of labor and Employment

Funding.
Committee shall be provided with an initial
annual allocation of FIFTY MILLION PESOS (~50,OOO,OOO.OO)
administrative and operational expenses, to be drawn from the contingency fund
of the Office of the President. Additional financial requirements that may be
needed by the Committee shall be sourced out by the Department of Budget and
Management from available funds of the concerned agencies outlined in this
Order J subject to the usual government accounting and auditing rules and
regulations.
